title: Align every statement of projection-repair scope with what repair rebuilds
outcome: Align the projection-repair scope in spec, shipped and sqlite-store docs with the code
acceptance: The `scope` field of the projection_repair_required refusal (src/bin_support/doctor/refusals.rs ~52, readiness fixture in src/bin_support/readiness.rs ~149) names the derived tables too, or the decision to keep it unchanged is recorded with its reason (it is emitted to hosts, so check TermAl's use of it first)
The doc comment on SqliteStore::repair_rebuildable_projections (src/storage/open_schema.rs ~227) and the storage reviewer lens (.claude/reviewers/storage.md ~31) state the same scope

docs/spec.md, docs/shipped.md and docs/features/sqlite-store.md describe `engram doctor --repair-projections` as rebuilding the declared indexes, triggers and search indexes and also the derived tables it drops and recreates (project-memory state, delivery bookkeeping, and the rebuilt work projection tables), matching src/storage/open_schema.rs and full-store-migration.md
